# Thunder Studio — Full Reference

> Professional music rehearsal rooms and recording studio in Don Mueang, Bangkok, Thailand.

Thunder Studio is a music rehearsal and recording facility located in Don Mueang, Bangkok. Part of Thunder Venture Group Co., Ltd. (Tax ID: 0105586164737). Open daily 10:00-22:00.

## Entity Summary

- Type: Music rehearsal studio and recording facility
- Location: Don Mueang, Bangkok, Thailand
- Parent company: Thunder Venture Group
- Languages: Thai, English
- Website: https://thundermusicstudio.com
- Booking: Online (SimplyBook.me), LINE @thunderstudio, phone

## Rooms

### Studio 1 — Large Rehearsal Room
- Capacity: 6-10 people
- Use case: Full bands, pre-gig rehearsals, weekly band practice
- Equipment:
  - Marshall guitar amplifiers
  - Full drum kit (kick, snare, toms, hi-hat, cymbals)
  - PA system with mixing capability
  - Microphones and stands (vocal + instrument)
- Soundproofing: Full perimeter soundproofing
- Ceiling: High ceiling for better acoustics
- [Details](https://thundermusicstudio.com/en/rooms/large-room)

### Studio 2 — Small Rehearsal Room
- Capacity: 2-4 people
- Use case: Solo practice, duos, acoustic sessions, small groups
- Equipment:
  - Guitar amplifier
  - PA system
  - Microphones and stands
- Soundproofing: Full perimeter soundproofing
- [Details](https://thundermusicstudio.com/en/rooms/small-room)

### Control Room — Recording Studio
- Capacity: 2-3 people
- Use case: Recording, mixing, mastering, podcast recording
- Equipment:
  - Mixing console
  - Rack gear (outboard processing)
  - Studio monitors (reference speakers)
  - DAW workstation (digital audio workstation)
- Acoustic treatment: Professional treatment for accurate monitoring
- [Details](https://thundermusicstudio.com/en/rooms/control-room)

## Services

| Service | Room | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| Band rehearsal (full) | Studio 1 | 6-10 person rehearsal with full backline |
| Solo/duo practice | Studio 2 | Private soundproofed room for 2-4 people |
| Recording | Control Room | Multi-track recording with mixing console |
| Mixing | Control Room | Post-production audio mixing |
| Mastering | Control Room | Final audio mastering for release |
| Podcast recording | Control Room | Podcast and voice-over recording |

## What's Included vs. What to Bring

Included in every room: Amplifiers, drum kit (Studio 1), PA system, microphones, stands, cables.
Bring yourself: Your own guitar or bass, spare strings, picks, drumsticks (optional backup), tuner.

## Booking Process

1. Choose your room (Studio 1, Studio 2, or Control Room)
2. Select date and time slot on the website or contact via LINE
3. Confirm booking (online or via staff)
4. Arrive 10 minutes early for setup
5. Session runs for your booked duration

Booking channels:

- By taxi/Grab: Tell driver "Baan Phasorn 48, Song Prapha Road, Don Mueang"

## FAQ

Q: Do I need to bring my own equipment?
A: Core equipment (amps, drums, PA, mics) is provided in every room. Just bring your own guitar or bass.

Q: How do I book?
A: Book online at thundermusicstudio.com, via LINE @thunderstudio, or call 063-546-1924.

Q: What are the opening hours?
A: Open daily 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM, including weekends and holidays.

Q: How many people can use each room?
A: Studio 1 fits 6-10 people (full band). Studio 2 fits 2-4 people (solo/duo). Control Room fits 2-3 people.

Q: Can I record in the rehearsal rooms?
A: Rehearsal rooms are designed for practice, not recording. Use the Control Room for professional recording with mixing console and DAW.

Q: Is parking available?
A: Yes, free parking is available on-site.

Q: Can I do podcast recording?
A: Yes, the Control Room is suitable for podcast recording with professional microphones, acoustic treatment, and a DAW workstation.

Q: What's the difference between mixing and mastering?
A: Mixing balances individual tracks (levels, EQ, effects) into a stereo mix. Mastering is the final step that optimizes the mixed audio for distribution (loudness, consistency, format).
